narrative.overview: Staff use this workspace between classes and at the gym desk. It prioritises scanning the day, finding a member and recording an arrival. The user-approved compact operations prototype is the authority, not the incomplete legacy interface.

rules.name: The Live Activity Rule
rules.body: Use court-lime where a real current class or check-in count earns it; never scatter it across ordinary controls.

dos: Do preserve compact density and readable row hierarchy.
Do keep 12px dropdown-chevron insets consistent across all forms.
Do present actual API counts and distinct permission-specific navigation.
Do distinguish synthetic local demo seed records from real gym claims.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, decorative charts, fake avatars, emoji icons or all-caps labels.
Don't ship fixtures, a role switch, browser token storage or fabricated fallback data.
Don't reinterpret the approved design direction when adding a new workflow.
